headline: Paraguay President Peña Resigns Amid Political Crisis Following Bank Collapse
summary: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña resigned following the collapse of digital lender ueno. Peña faces a criminal investigation and potential removal proceedings before the Senate.
why: The sudden collapse of a major commercial lender and the resulting political turmoil create sovereign risk and economic uncertainty in Paraguay, directly impacting domestic asset valuations.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Presidential resignation and bank collapse introduce severe political and financial instability in Paraguay.
